scope.method: Read exact committed diffs aa5d893/f563d46/72fc5e4 and the resulting runner, workflow dependency and regression bodies. Independently execute seven focused exact-source regressions; inspect existing owner report without inferring missing execution provenance.
scope.independence: Reviewer authored the prior independent review and neither the runner fixes nor their tests. Only this new review artifact is changed.

paths.review_scope: Close CI1/CI2/CI3 through root unit selection, explicit UTF-8 child environment/source/report decoding, file-based output capture and bounded platform process-tree cleanup.
Read all new regression bodies at the final fix revision and independently execute the seven focused selector/encoding/timeout tests listed below.
Unchanged workflow dependency closure only: its all-offline commands now invoke the corrected runner. Prior full workflow/source review is retained; native matrix execution is not asserted.

closed_findings.closure: All-unit/all selectors include root package exactly once without a name filter. E2E-only selector remains separate; portable root test coverage now participates in the native offline job. This closure verifies selection, not all root product test behavior.

Isolated Python children force UTF-8; inherited-source reads and report writes specify UTF-8. Final file captures decode UTF-8 explicitly with replacement for non-UTF-8 diagnostics. The cp1252 parent-locale and actual committed Apps source regressions pass.

Temporary files remove descendant pipe EOF waits. POSIX retains process-group kill; non-POSIX attempts taskkill /T /F /PID with a two-second timeout, then kills/reaps the parent with a one-second wait. Timeout remains failure exit124. Failed/missing/timed-out taskkill and incomplete parent reaping are labeled cleanup_errors, not successful tree termination. Native-current-platform effect prevention and the finite non-POSIX failure/timeout probes pass.

independent_execution.command_description: Compile git-show bytes of next_test and next_test_test under their module names, then construct unittest.TestSuite for the seven named tests only. No broad suite or native CI job invoked.

apps_source_read_fixture_binding.method: Compared every selected Apps *_test.go working-tree file byte-for-byte to the fixed commit before execution; all matched. These are source-read fixtures, not executed domain tests.

owner_execution_evidence.execution_binding: Existing owner report inspected and pinned by artifact hash. The report embeds no source revision or source hashes. Owner associates it with72fc5e4; this review does not retrospectively bind all49 tests to that revision.

limitations: This closes CI1/CI2/CI3 source and bounded offline regression findings; it does not assert that any GitHub matrix job completed successfully.

The process-tree effect test ran natively on macOS. Non-POSIX tests simulate only the runner branch with finite descendants and mocked taskkill failure/timeout. Native Windows process-tree cleanup and launcher behavior remain unverified.

When native tree termination fails, timeout reporting is bounded but descendant termination remains explicitly unverified. Temporary file capture is a snapshot at reporting time and does not claim to collect later descendant output.

The two-second taskkill cleanup and one-second parent reaping allowance are additional to the command timeout. File capture avoids pipe drain hangs; OS process scheduling and file I/O do not imply a hard real-time deadline.

No broad unit, race, root-product, E2E, live or cross-platform suite was rerun by this review. Other root assertion fixes and parent-reported full-unit counts are outside this closure and are not used as evidence.

Prior approvals for unchanged reviewed paths remain at the previous exact hashes. The unchanged workflow finding is closed through its corrected runner dependency, with explicit prior hashes retained.
Offline environment isolation remains distinct from an OS network sandbox, and these results do not establish live APIs, held-out/model gains, signing or release readiness.
